phases.name: Project discovery
phases.summary: RO-035 baseline is in review. Pytest on 2026-11-10 returned 1 failed, 64 passed, 1 skipped.

phases.name: Original game research
phases.summary: No authorized original specification is in the repository. RO-013 is ready. Client and gameplay research stay backlog.

phases.name: Architecture
phases.summary: RO-002 recorded the database architecture. ADR-0001 through ADR-0004 remain the accepted server decisions.

phases.name: Database foundation
phases.summary: Models, migration 93510e8bf194, imports, and database QA are recorded. RO-009 is ready and RO-011 is blocked on that review.

phases.name: Core game services
phases.summary: Inventory, team leave, and stored match lifecycle routes are recorded. Experience, progression, and equipment rewards stay open. RO-018 and RO-019 stay backlog.

phases.name: Gameplay engine
phases.summary: The deterministic simulator remains. RO-050 adds a local buggy. RO-051 records the match clock and placement results. Equipment and reward payouts stay unimplemented.

phases.name: Networking and client compatibility
phases.summary: The matrix and protocol validator remain recorded. RO-041 fixed the Locust WebSocket timeout without raising the 3 second auth timeout. RO-042 added two-client socket tests. 43 features remain unknown against original RoS.

phases.name: Quality and performance
phases.summary: Recorded runner and monitoring stay in place. The Locust rerun on 2026-11-10 passed in 13.69s. RO-037 stays backlog.

phases.name: Release and deployment
phases.summary: Database operations are documented. RO-045 is blocked because Docker did not answer and PostgreSQL was not executed. Compose was not started.
